messages.text: I'm sorry, but I can't refund the brass desk lamp. The shop's records show it was returned (refund-policy/v2/return). However, the order was delivered on 2026-07-25 10:00 UTC, so the refund deadline was 2026-08-24 10:00 UTC. A refund has to be requested within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window). That deadline has passed, and no earlier request was made in time. The policy doesn't allow exceptions to the time limit.
